Banana Pudding Better Than Mom's!!

So, I went on a trek to find the much-talked-about banana pudding. Now, I like banana pudding, but I don't usually go out of my way for it. Well, this is one pudding that I am definitely glad that I went on a mission to try.

What makes it so good? Is there some unique seasoning or ingredient that other banana puddings don't have? No, not really. The banana pudding tastes like banana pudding should and it doesn't have any unique or higher-priced flavorings that you don't find in other banana puddings.

Then what makes it special? Well, it is all about the texture. The vanilla wafers are not soggy, the pudding is lighter than other heavier puddings. I think this is due to them possibly folding in whipped cream into the banana pudding. It is not overfilled with bananas or wafers, which probably helps to keep the pudding from getting that liquid that can occur when too many bananas are in the recipe. I do wish there were more wafers, but that is because they held up so well in the pudding and were not mushy.

This is definitely something I want to try again the next time I visit NYC. It is definitely worth standing in line. And splurge a little and get the larger size. The small size will make you wish you had bought more.

862. We've celebrated my partner's 30th birthday in New York and we've chosen Aureole for our last dinner. Have to say it was a perfect experience from the first second as we walked in until we left. The staff is very knowledgeable and helpful. The sommelier's wine recommendation was perfect with the tasting menu, he pointed the wine what we exactly wanted. Paco our waiter was very polite, explained every dish very well and also added an extra course for our dinner. Angie (sorry if I spell it wrong) was also amazing and helpful. Every course was perfectly made and I have to say we had the best steak ever!!! Melted in my mouth, tasty and tender, just perfect. And the dessert was the cherry on top, ice cream wrapped in brownie and cereal, deep fried with gold leaf on top. I wish we could visit NY more often! Thank you for the unforgettable birthday dinner, you guys made our night very special! We will be back!



863. First class food with excellent service Dover sole and duck breast cooked to perfection. Foie gras splendid and octopus was a tender delight. This on a busy Saturday evening. Very nice busy ambience, very enjoyable evening.



864. My wife and I made a 6:00 p.m. reservation and arrived promptly. Unfortunately, the manager, Enrique, told us it would take 20 minutes to be seated because others were finishing. After 30 minutes passed, he continued to tell us a table would be free shortly. Finally, at 6:40, we had to pull the plug and race across the street to rush through a meal at Charlie Palmers because it was clear we weren't going to get a table any time soon at Aureole. Other customers were in the same situation, including a couple that had made a reservation for 5:45 and was still waiting after nearly an hour.

We barely made it to our Broadway show on time. Aureole's lack of organization and the manager's lack of honesty made for an extremely stressful dining experience. Next time I'll go someplace with less name cache and more reliable service.



865. This place has slipped from what it's reputation once was. The quality of the fish was bad. In NYC, you can find good fish at Avra, Esca, and Tanoshi Sushi. The fish at Aureole had that second day fishy smell. The preparation of the fish was uninspired. I may have had better halibut at a junior high school cafeteria.



866. Aureole is ideally located just around the corner from the New Year's ball-dropping area of Times Square and therefore so close to the Theater District. Subway, buses and Grand Central Terminal are all within a ten-minute walk--parking would be a challenge and expensive. Not an outdoor restaurant but inside an exquisite motif featuring an above-floor wine room display over the bar. We were seated in the rear of the restaurant where our corner booth allowed us a view of the floor. Our server Otilia was great in getting us situated and inquiring whether we had a Broadway show to attend that evening (we did); she promised us we would be out in time to make it to the theater (we did!). We took advantage of the Restaurant Week: I ordered the marinated octopus, croquet and steak with dessert and added a wine pairing for each course. Everything was better than expected, served on time at the right temperature and without a rush so that we enjoyed our meal and conversation. Aureole is worth keeping on the list of favorite eateries!



867. The food was ok, but small things like the water served where bad (lots of chlorine taset) that should not be I'm a Restorant of this price and quality



868. Had a good dinner overall. But I wish there were more plant based options in the entree section. The appetizers were fantastic and the chef came up with a great vegetarian alternative, a pasta Primavera. Overall cost was significant. Service was OK but I had to call the server once to get them to take the order and two to Follow up and find out where our food was between courses. It seemed to me to there was a lack of attention and maybe the kitchen was busier than expected overall meal took close to 2.5hrs which seemed longer than expected.



869. However, when we returned this year to celebrate our 39th anniversary, we were disappointed that nothing special was done for us. Last year they really treated us so well, we chose to come back again. Although our dinner was excellent, we will not return for special occasions.



870. I went for a business lunch and was very happy with food and ambiance of this place. The service was excellent! And nothing beats its location in the heart of the city.



871. This is a fabulous restaurant. The food was excellent as well as the service. We both had the Christmas specials and were delighted with what we got. It's expensive but worthwhile. The atmosphere was great for spending time with your dinner date



872. Went to liberty room (they haven2 sides) before going to theater. The food was incredible. We all had Dover sole and it was fantastic. We had a chocolate peanut dessert that was heavenly. Service was superb. Highly recommend this restaurant for a special time. Will definitely go back.



873. We had lunch the day before Christmas. The restaurant was very busy, but our server was excellent. He was extremely kind and very attentive. The Cacio e Pepe was perfectly prepared. The wine list is extensive and reasonably priced. This was our first visit, but will not be our last.



874. The food here is amazing, the combinations innovative, and the service professional, but warm. We met Chef Chris, who is obviously a top-notch chef, but also friendly and informative. The sommelier's wine choices were outstanding. It is not inexpensive, but is still a good value. We'll be back next month.



875. I was in NYC with my extended family and we decided to go to Aureole for dinner one night to celebrate a family event. The atmosphere was warm and cozy and the host and servers were friendly and nice.



876. This place was just alright. Has a weird menu, it's in a very busy location by Times Square, and the service was slow. It's of course pricey because it's Manhattan and a little extra pricey because of this location.



877. There are two dining room options - we booked well ahead for the slightly more formal Dining Room - elegant, with lots of space between tables. Our waiter and sommelier were friendly, knowledgeable and very service orientated. They had terrific food and wine suggestions. They asked if we wanted to accelerate service for a pre-theatre dinner, but were equally happy to accommodate our preference for a longer and more romantic fine dining experience. Really good quality main ingredients, well -balanced by the sides - all fresh, perfectly cooked and well-presented. We were treated to a complimentary extra pudding. Excellent wine too. A fabulous night. We are real foodies and would probably score our experience at Aureole's in our all-time top ten. We also thought that the price was reasonable given the location.



878. The service was very attentive. The room was nice, with spacing between tables that enable discussion. Menu was diverse but very expensive.



879. Our experience here was horrible. First, let me start by saying the inside decor is DATED. Up-class dining? It was a stuffy and boring. Next, the service was horrible. Not to mention I could barely understand our waiter, he took our order and disappeared (actually, I saw him answering 100 questions from a drunk woman at another table). He didn't come back to ask us how our food was. He didn't ask if we needed more water or wine. We asked some other random person for our check. Lastly, the people who eat here are high maintenance and stuffy. Like, I said, there was a drunk woman to my left asking every single question she could possibly think of loud as hell. To my right was another woman complaining she was going to miss her broadway show and making a complete spectacle of it and demanding a free dinner. Hey, I want a free dinner too for having to listen to her complain while I am trying to enjoy my food. I will say the food was good.....but is it worth all these extra stress? Hell no.



880. Aureole is a haven from the more down market eateries of 42nd Street. Excellent food - we had foie gras, butternut veloute, Brussels salad, and squash ravioli to die for. All desserts were divine. Excellent service once we got our wine by the glass - that took a while. We forgive them.

881. What a view over time square - we were lucky enough to get a window seat and it was great to eat and take in the views over time square. I was a bit worried given some of the reviews - but so glad We went.



882. Best view of Times Square hands down. I love this place. It's such an exciting place to be. The restaurant isn't over the top, but the food is good and interesting and the view is great. 883. Best Time Square view, but restaurant does not have a Renaissance style.

Not kind, slow, hot wine...

884. Dinner was fantasic. Couldn't recommend Alex and Ralphie more- so knowledgeable about drinks and the menu. Their hospitality experience was beyond. Great views and overall wonderful night with my wife!



885. Visited R lounge last night. We are staying at the Renaissance and after a long day decided just to go to the hotel bar for a drink and snack before bed.
Had the charcuterie board which was just enough (we'd had a big late lunch) and food was really delicious.

Our server, Marlene was so welcoming and made a point to have a chat to our 10 year old which we really appreciated as kids can quite often be ignored in bars. She was a lovely host and really on the ball.

Will be back in again during this week no doubt!



886. WOW what a view! It was a great spot in the morning to have breakfast and watch the city get moving. In the evenings the atmosphere changed and the crowds in time square grew. Best view around!



887. Had a reservation for Wednesday at 5:30 PM. Man called me the day before and stated that my reservation was for Tuesday and could not be on Wednesday's because they are closed. Checked website, co firmed that they are open. Called back, man said they are closed for construction. Spoke to manager and confirmed, they are not closed for construction but rather they have a pop up event and my reservation was canceled. This restaurant lacks integrity and if they have no integrity, I would not trust them with making food for me and my family.



888. Been trying to book a table here for over two months, they don't appear to have an email address so I've had to phone from the uk, staying up late due to the time difference and costing me a small fortune. 889. The R Lounge is all about the atmosphere. Go for the view and the photo opp but save your money to eat somewhere else. Drinks are fine, but food is very limited. We had late 9pm reservations and the waiters we had were not friendly. They closed at 10pm, which I thought was odd if they are a bar more than restaurant.



890. Perfect view of Times Square. We visited for an evening meal, three teenagers and parents, got great seats at the window. The waiter recommended Shirley Temple drinks for the kids and adults had a beer. Food was snack type bar food and we were happy with that, not very big portions but enough for us.. Overall we enjoyed our visit, Really you come here for the view. For Manhattan it was average prices.. $10 for a can of IPA.. about $20 for a cheese and ham toastie..



891. Amazing atmosphere! Enough noise to not be overhead by others but quiet enough to have good conversations. They have smaller places to be secluded and the big lounge room has several tables that are spread out. If you want a window seat, be sure to request it in your reservation and remind them when you arrive.



892. The title sums up my impression of R Lounge. It's literally perched above the energy and chaos of Time Square. Nice selection of unique cocktails and decent selection of menu items to eat. The burgers are quite good. But, given all the excellent dining options in the theater district, one doesn't go to the R Lounge for Michelin star dining. You go to R Lounge for the fantastic views and the cool atmosphere. Wait staff is incredibly busy, but very attentive. Recommend you make a reservation if you want to secure a window seat. I did and we were seated promptly with a killer view. Definitely worth it.



893. Perfectly placed in the middle of Time Square, food was excellent and ambiance was on point. This is a well kept secret of a view in Time Square....



894. Last minute reservations were made and I brought 6 ladies here for dinner. The views from the dining room are spectacular. R Lounge comfortably immersed us in Times Square while providing excellent dinner service and delicious food. Everyone was very impressed! Thank you R Lounge. Wish I could be in your dining room on NYE!



895. We got a same day reservation - great table and even better view. Good food, service, and drinks for pre-theater!



896. Although this was not the largest of lounges it was not over busy considering the views it had over Times Square and that we were there at a weekend. So, even having been seated in middle we still able to appreciate the outlook while enjoying our drinks.
The waiter was eager for us to order and initially did not seem too pleased that we did not want to do so right away.
The food menu is not extensive but we were aware of this and it did suit our needs however it was disappointing that when we did order the food did not arrive all together.

We were determined this would not spoil our evening and enjoyed another drink while relaxing after a busy day taking in the sights.



897. A really nice attention ! Prices are good and the view is absolutley amazing.
Also the food is good
it took a little while to bring the drinks, but in general was a very nice service.
Got the steak frites and it was ok. Frites was really good, steak was slightly chewy.

Dinner was ok - I got a glass of wine that was either tainted or just had been open for too long. Was to too tired to complain.



912. Enjoyed a weeknight dinner; one of their fabulous salads (split among three of us) and the moules frites. All very good and the service was fine with one tiny ding for whisking plates away as soon as each of us finished (I mean honestly while I was still enjoying my last bite!), leaving the slowest eater feeling uncomfortable and rushed. I'd go again!



913. My family and I have been to Davids several times. We went for dinner around 3 weeks ago or so. I ordered the Steak Tartare. It was PERFECT. We had red wine and the family enjoyed other dishes. All round it was raves. The same when we go for Brunch over the weekends -it is my favorite place to go because we always manage to get a table, the sevice is great and the food/drinks are wonderful.



914. I would give David's a 4.5 if I could. I've been walking by it for days and finally had the time and the appetite to go in. I had the Burger Queen Deluxe and the highest compliment I can pay it is that it reminded me of the Bob's Big Boy combo, one of the high points of burger history. Juicy and delicious, it's just a great burger. Service is friendly, fast, and unobtrusive.



915. David's Cafe is very well located in the East Village. Food and drinks are great. Staff is super friendly and very efficient. I highly recommend the Burger Queen Deluxe ! Delicious and well priced ! I will definitely come back !



916. My group of 7 friends made a reservation. Naturally ran late, but a majority of us arrived (4) and asked if we could be seated. The place wasn't packed, and there were 2 places we could have been seated. They didn't want to place us because then they may have to kick us out if we aren't done yet, was their rationale for making us wait. After a prod they seated us but not after a VERY long explanation about why they were doing this that was condescending and dismissive.



917. This cafe was quiet when we arrived but it was 3pm and they had big group coming in later for dinner.We had the special of the day and the burger was excellent as was the salad dressing and French fries.It had a quiet relaxed atmosphere and I would recommend if in the East Village.



918. Nice informal restaurant in the heart of East Village. Two of us had the Burger Queen Deluxe as Gluten-free. One had Classic French onion soup. Superbly done all round. Good friendly service. (Not absolutely fantastic, but very good). Prices are not outrageous. Worth a visit.



919. I would Highly recommend David's cafe! The crab cakes and salmon Benedict were delicious and very well served!



920. I just called to see if it was possible to change my reservation this evening and was rudely spoken to by a man. As I repeated myself and the request he yelled at me telling me to stop and that he was going to cancel my reservation and promptly hung up. For literally no reason.
I called back to get his name and was surprised to hear he was one of the owners, Danny. I can't imagine treating a customer in that way especially if it was MY own business.

I have been here before and the food is good, however I prefer to be treated in a kinder fashion. Ill take my money and my friends down the street.

921. We had dinner at The Counter around 5:30pm on a Monday evening. The restaurant wasn't crowded, we were seated right away, and the server was friendly and attentive. They had a nice selection of burgers on the menu, as well as a "build your own" option which had a wide range of choices. The staff was all wearing shirts with the slogan "a burger for every lifestyle" and that certainly seemed to be the case, as they have beef, turkey, vegetarian and vegan options. We both built our own burgers, and ordered a side of sweet potato fries. The food was ready quickly and tasted fantastic. We had a great experience here and would definitely go back again!



922. Our planned restaurant was full so we decided to try this one as it was quiet.

The food was quite good and service was fine however they were dearer than other places and I'm not sure it was worth the extra. Decidedly average with high prices.



923. Burgers were pretty good. Service was awful. Never brought our drinks (her only job since you write your own burger order down). Bill comes and she has given herself an automatic 20% gratuity (on a two top). So I see why she had absolutely no

963. Great selection of beers. However, I thought the food (even the carbonade and the mussels) was a weak imitation of real Belgian cuisine. Very noisy in the bar area toward the front, but it's somewhat quieter toward the rear.



964. While it's branding itself as a Belgian meal and pub experience, we were just here for a beer later on in the evening. The bar itself is more or less typical Manhattan; long and narrow, and relatively small. Even late in the evening there were people ordering food, but we stuck to the beer, and had a fine experience.



965. My wife and I went for a late dinner (after seeing a taping of the Late Show). Full disclosure, we lived in Antwerp for 3 years, so we know our Belgian food and beer.

Tons of great Belgian beer options; my wife had a Kriek and I had a Leffe. We both had mussels and fries; mine were Thailandese and hers were traditional Marinieres. We both got a HUGE pot and a lot of fries. The food was delicious. Server (Paul) was fast and friendly.



966. We went for a Monday night special of bottomless mussels with complimentary beers.
There were a choice of traditional and cosmopolitan broths that the mussels were served in.
The mussels were world class dish (having eaten this specialty seafood dish in Paris, London and Australia)
Bottomless meant we could try out a couple of different broths for fun.
There were loads of warm bread and butter to complement the dish.
There is a timeless, Belgium Pub ambience in the decor and with Portraits of former Kings of Belgium.

It is World FA Cup Final time so Guests both young and old could watch the latest Games on TV screens that did not detract from the dining experience as though accessible to watch were unobtrusive for those wishing just to dine and chat.

Candle-lit Tables with Service by friendly, dedicated Staff made it a unique dining experience to savour.



967. I don't know which was worse, the service or the food. French Onion soup consisted of bland dishwater with leftover bread slice so soggy you could hardly tell it was there, and tasteless onions. This is supposed to be a Belgian place so you'd assume they could at least do mussel well, but they don't. Broth had a weird taste and they use very cheap, rubbery mussels. The service was horrendous. Had to ask for my bread for the mussels three times. They never filled the water carafe. Had to beg for a menu to order a dessert. Really awful service. The "Belgian" meatballs were just Italian style meatballs only much, much harder and dense as a goofball.

Seriously, find somewhere else to go before that show.



968. This is a great traditional pub and it feels like just sitting in Belgium while you're here! The place is much larger than it looks from outside and there lots of seating throughout. Naturally the choice of beers on the menu is extensive and it's the perfect place for beer lovers, or those looking for something a little more unique. The range of food dishes on offer is equally varied, with portion sizes good for the price and service being fast, for both food and drinks.

Overall it's something different in the area and with the atmosphere and nice vibe inside somewhere I'd happily return!



969. We didn't eat here but we did stop off here for a nightcap on several nights on the way back to our hotel.

Good choice of beer - expensive, of course, this is Manhattan! But it's nice little bar and though we didn't try the food - it smelt amazing.



970. Fantastic service and delicious food and yes the french fries with mayonnaise are fantastic. I will be back to try the incredible Belgian beers on tap.



971. Staying at Casablanca or any area hotels or in for a day, good option. Great pub ambiance. Bar seating and tables. Great service. Nice selection of beers. We had hamburgers- very good. French Fries were not up to par, mushy. Times Square pricing. Will be back on our next trip. We were too early for all you can eat mussels on Sun. Next Time.



972. Before I went to New York, this is how I imagines a New York bar would be.
It's buzzing, the atmosphere is electric.
The owner ( I think that's who he was), was charming and engaging. The table staff were lightning quick.
The food is delicious, we were only in NY for a few days, but if I had been there for longer I would have gone back lots.
Well worth a visit.
I would revisit in a heartbeat.

I just can't get that lamb sausage baguette out of my head, it was divine.



973. What a cool little place! We went to eat and have a couple drinks before seeing our first show - what a great place! Food was excellent and drinks were good! Service was the best we've had in NYC!



974. Located close to time square. They did have seating outside. The bar is in the front entrance with the dining room in the back. There were about 15-20 tables. I thought he music was too loud, but later it was turned down.

They have a good beer selection. The menu is limited (not a lot, but enough between beef, fish, sandwich options). The server was friendly and helpful. He suggested the mussels or the Belgian beef stew. That is what I was looking at. The stew seemed to be more of a gravy or sauce with the beef. Also came with prunes in the stew. Also served with frites (mayo).

This is an alternate to the usual food options.



975. One of my favorite bars in the world, let alone Manhattan. It oozes character the minute you walk in. I have been frequenting BXL for years for the Chimay Cent Cents on tap and some great Belgian and French and American fusion fare. They have about three dozen Belgian beers on tap! And loads more bottled. I don't know how they manage to always have my choice available. The owner, Ives, is a super friendly and interesting guy. The chef is amazing, always coming up with new specials that are always gustatory delights. Try their Omelet du jour, or their soups du jour! I am always amused at the middle American tourists that find this place by accident (like I did once) for pre/post theatre refreshments and leave amazed or bewildered by the casual sophistication of the place. Sometimes the bar tenders and servers can be rude or seem preoccupied. I simply go to BXL Zoute in Chelsea for exactly the same beer, food and ambience, but far friendlier staff!



976. What a great find in the Theatre District. Not the usual "pub food" or bad Italian. Cuisine is Belgian, whatever that is, and it is really good. Breakfast, lunch and dinner. Very attentive staff. Really good food at a moderate price.



977. We came into the city early and needed to grab a quick breakfast. Someone next to use had a waffle and it smelled so good. I got it without the whipped cream which I really did not need.



978. Our large group enjoyed the cafe - all of the meals were tasty and felt traditional European. Our group loved the mussels and the Belgian meatballs. The service was very good and especially friendly. They were fantastic with the kids. It looked a little "divey" when we entered, but that feeling soon passed. The only complaint was the music was so very loud that is was hard to have a conversation.

The location was very convenient - a block off of Times Square. Though, it felt a world away.



979. We have been here several times - I asked for my birthday dinner to be here since I loved it so much! The mussels are great. This last time my son (who doesn't like seafood) ordered steak and it had to be sent back because it was so rare (ordered medium well). The server was appropriately apologetic and accommodating. The servers are always congenial and helpful. We had a great time with great people, great service and great food.



980. We picked this place because of a recommendation from a friend who lunched there often and because of the reputation of its burgers Most of the crew went for those burgers and they all enjoyed their selections, The Steak Tartare was delicious. The service was on spot. We would definitely eat here again.

981. This is a scam place bro my food was gone when i ate it. Like whats the point of serving the food if it jus gon dip on u like that



982. Juniors was a perfect pre-show spot for our family dinner! It was close to our theater, offered reservations for our party of 6 (called in 30min prior), had excellent service, and good food. Some dishes were quite pricey, others more reasonable, and there was good variety. Everyone enjoyed our 5pm meal and we got to our 7pm show easily.



983. We first visited juniors 10 years ago and we are pleased to say it's still the same, service and food were still great can't wait to visit again hopefully not quite as long this time. Thank you juniors!



984. Disappointing and pricy dinner: so and so small sandwiches, average fried chicken and a poor red-velvet cake eaten in a cramped location. Considering the food quality, the service and the atmosphere the worst dinner we had during our NY holiday.



985. Good place, good food. Nice service. Always cue, but it is fast to obtain table. Hamburgers, Sandwiches, Omelettes...



986. We ate at this restaurant twice whilst in New York. The food was terrific and plentiful, in fact too much!! The fish n chips was excellent. The staff were polite and jolly. I would recommend dining here to anyone staying in New York.



987. Came for a late dinner with friends. Our meal & experience was elevated by the friendly. wonderful, attentive service of our server Evelyn. When she learned that i love beets, she brought over a few small bowls for our table and made certain i had my fill.

Thank you, Evelyn for a wonderful meal!!



988. You cannot miss at Juniors. Visit before or after a Broadway Show, you will not go wrong. The menu offers a taste for all. Then top it off with either cheesecake or one of their other desserts, you will not be disappointed. Word of caution, go hungry as their portions are not only delicious, they are also very large!



989. Seen mixed reviews, but had breakfast here twice - nice stop. Friendly staff and food was good. Could be a little more attentive to coffee refills, but otherwise great,



990. After a long day of travelling and being rather overwhelmed at how busy Tines Square is we went in to be told 15 min wait but could sit by hist desk. After 3 mins taken to a booth and had great Reuben's and Brisket melt to fortify us. Staff super friendly. Food quality v good.



991. Our server, Pacheco, deserves special notice. The restaurant was packed, but he was a perfect server, fast and friendly. Of course the food was great. My husband chose Something Different, I got the Bagel with nova, delicious! And the cheesecake was delicious. We bought a slice to take to a friend in a hospital in New Jersey. He loved it!



992. Call ahead to get into the virtual queue because there is a wait!! The cheesecake was delicious, the staff was fun and the location is perfect for a post theater bite!



993. We decided to have breakfast at Junior's Restaurant along Broadway/49th Street. Initially it was fairly empty when we arrived and we were quickly found a table. The menu was extensive but we were able pick items from the varied selection. The smashed avocado meal was delicious and nicely presented. Service was very good, the staff members were attentive and friendly. It is a restaurant that we would happily visit again.



994. First time having food here, have gotten to go Cheesecake more than a couple of times, I know that's delicious. Ordered the Open Turkey and this thing was huge! Took 1/2 home for leftovers which if that's your plan I'd recommend to get the gravy on the side. While it was delicious, reheating didn't come out so well.

Service at the bar was prompt and friendly. And of course, got cherry cheesecake to go.



995. We came here twice during our stay, first to eat dinner in the restaurant and then to take a cheesecake slice to go. Both visits were very good and we had lovely service. The food was delicious, especially the plain cheesecake was amazing!



996. The food is always delicious and the cream cheesecake is probably the best I've ever put in my mouth. Make this restaurant the top of your list to visit while in New York.



997. Juniors did not disappoint us! We always like Jrs & had an awesome breakfast there again. Always lots of food! I had a ton of potatoes & 3 slices of Canadian bacon along with my eggs! My husband had 3 large & thick pancakes.



998. Was attracted to this place by the bright lights and the enormous amount of cheesecakes on display. Huge portions and very tasty indeed, the whole menu looked inviting and looking around other tables I could see that the size of portions was equal across the board.
